newsitem.title: FRANCE: Fresh wave of attacks in Corsica, no one injured.
newsitem.headline: Fresh wave of attacks in Corsica, no one injured.

text.p: Suspected Corsican separatists fired shots at a gendarmerie barracks and set off four bombs on the island overnight, French police said on Tuesday.

No casualties were reported in the attacks on the barracks in Figari and offices belonging to the AXA insurance company in Ajaccio, the shipping company SNCM in Ile Rousse and the hunters' federation in Bastia.
No one has claimed responsibility for the attacks.
Gendarmes said they counted 26 bullet impacts on the gates of the barracks.
The "Historic Wing" of the Corsican National Liberation Front (FLNC) has claimed responsibility for a number of previous attacks on gendarmerie barracks.

The separatist guerrilla group has staged a two-decade-old bombing campaign in Corsica. It recently embarked on a showdown with the Paris government which has pledged to restore law and order on the French Mediterranean island.
